product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Lacquer Side End Table Nightstand, Grey and Walnut
product.description: This sleek mid-century side table will be a handsome addition to your room while displaying framed photos and other treasured items on top. A second shelf below and a drawer are handy places to stash keys, phones and more. 17.7"L x 14.2"W x 23.6"H Engineered wood with walnut veneer Mid-century modern A compact, convenient piece for any room in need of a small side table Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
